title: Skeggy's Axe House
specs: Arcade with games including foosball, Pac-Man, air hockey, skee-ball, shuffleboard
Guests under 18 must have an adult present in the axe-throwing area
All participants must wear closed-toe shoes
Participants must follow rules and instructions from Chucker Instructors
9 axe-throwing lanes available for groups and parties
blurb: Guests participate in axe throwing sessions with instructors guiding them. The venue has 9 axe-throwing lanes and an arcade with games like foosball, Pac-Man, air hockey, and more. It is suitable for parties, birthdays, and casual visits.
extraNote: No outside beverages allowed; drinks must be purchased at The Sakade · Staff and instructors reserve the right to refuse participation or end activity for safety
